description: Budget delivery (pacing) mode lookup for one or more PLA campaigns: returns budget_delivery_mode (ACCELERATED vs STANDARD) per campaign_id (marketing_campaign_id) from marketing_campaign_dimensions. Point-in-time dimension lookup (no date range), keyed by a mandatory campaign_id filter; the Python layer buckets ids into accelerated/standard/not-found and computes the summary counts.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd JOIN reporting.clients AS clients ON clients.client_id = mcd.client_id WHERE clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
